place.source_title: Piggly Wiggly Grocery Store, 537-541 Salem Avenue

brief: One-storey 1920s chain grocery store: a brick front with a wide recessed glass storefront under a continuous signboard, a flat roof and plain side walls; now vacant beside a weedy lot.

facade.notes: the Piggly Wiggly grocery (Dayton, 1925): a one-storey brick store with a deco-patterned parapet framing two big sign panels (now blank), its whole front boarded; a vacant lot beside
